$comment: Viewer-capture seconds per parity fixture (both ambient-occlusion captures together) for the four `Viewer references` shards of .github/workflows/viewer-parity.yml, which deal the fixtures with scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts. Source: 181 successful shard jobs of merge-queue and main-push runs of ci.yml, 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-12, at least 45 samples per fixture; each fixture's value is its runner-speed-normalised median (a per-job speed factor fitted across the job's fixtures, since hosted runners differ by up to 3x on SwiftShader). A fixture not listed weighs defaultSeconds, the median fixture. Refresh when a fixture is added or a listed value moves by more than a quarter.
